estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

fotos.cena: Close-up of a man's hands filling the cells of a seed tray with light, fine seed-starting mix; the small mascot figurine sits on an upturned clay pot next to the tray
Close-up of a man's fingers dropping two large seeds into a shallow finger-made hole in a small pot of soil
Close-up of a man's hand snipping a weaker seedling at soil level with small scissors, leaving the strongest one in the pot
A seed tray of tall, thin, pale leggy seedlings all bent and leaning toward a window
Young beetroot seedlings with red-veined leaves growing in a pot
Freshly pulled small carrots with their green tops on a wooden table
A zucchini plant with a yellow flower and a small fruit in a garden bed; the small mascot figurine peeks out from under a large zucchini leaf
A bush green bean plant with hanging pods growing in a pot on a balcony
